$comment: Entry schema for contributes.httpCodeGenerators (declarative and process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_http_code_generators.go and the shared template parser in plugins/api/codetmpl. The template is a .tmpl asset under codegen/, templates/ or assets/ (UTF-8, no NUL, no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters) written in a logic-less Mustache subset: {{variable}}, {{variable|filter}} (one filter), {{#section}}...{{/section}}, {{^section}}...{{/section}} and {{! comment}}. Triple braces, {{&...}}, partials ({{>...}}), delimiter changes ({{=...=}}), whitespace inside tags and unknown names or filters are rejected; item variables (name, value) and first/last are valid only inside a list section, list sections do not nest, sections nest at most 3 deep and a template has at most 2048 nodes. A bare {{variable}} uses the entry's escape; the filter raw emits the value verbatim. The template renders in the host UI against a redacted request model: auth values, sensitive headers and keys and credential-shaped values become YOUR_* placeholders and environment variables stay literal {{name}} references. The plugin process never sees request data.
description: HTTP code generators: extra targets in the HTTP request code-generation dialog, rendered from a data-only template.

title.description: Generator name shown in the code-generation dialog, labelled with the plugin name.

escape.description: Escaping applied to every bare {{variable}}: none, json (quoted JSON string), shell (POSIX single quotes), powershell (single quotes), cstring (double-quoted C-style string), xml or url (encodeURIComponent).

template.description: Package-relative .tmpl template. Variables: requestName, method, url, urlBase, scheme, host, path, body, bodyType, contentType, graphqlQuery, graphqlVariables. List sections: query, headers, formFields, variables (items expose name and value, plus the first/last sections). Flag sections: hasQuery, hasHeaders, hasBody, hasJsonBody, hasFormBody, hasBinaryBody, hasGraphql, hasVariables. Filters: raw, json, jsonInner, shell, powershell, cstring, xml, url, upper, lower.
